summary: Apollo Asset Backed Credit Co LLC filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of multiple share classes totaling ~$54 million in aggregate consideration, plus NAV per share updates and distribution declarations for Series I and II. This is a routine periodic capital raise and NAV disclosure by a closed-end fund, not a special situation. There is no merger, acquisition, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or forced management change. The filing merely updates ongoing equity issuance and fund pricing.
